name: Jikininki wa Dare ga Tabeta
original_name: ジキニンキは誰が食べた
source:
At the scene of a beautiful female student’s murder, the words “Who ate the Jikininki?” were left behind. The murdered student came back to life as an entity only I could see and began investigating her own murder case. The closer we got to the truth, the more a horrifying history tied to the Jikininki and the school was revealed.
A “Cannibalistic Love Horror” unraveling the life and habits as well as history of the Jikininki.
Through three stories depicting the relationship between the Jikininki and the female students, you’ll come closer to the truth about the Jikininki.

[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1547934]dlsite[/url]]
